question: The government of which state started the Tansen Samman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tansen Samman** is an award initiated by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• This award is given in the field of Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is named after the legendary musician **Tansen**, who was one of the nine gems in the court of Mughal Emperor Akbar.
 
• The award aims to recognize outstanding contributions to the field of music.
 
• The state of Madhya Pradesh is known for its rich cultural heritage and contributions to classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tansen**, also known as Ramtanu Pandey, was a prominent figure in Hindustani classical music.
 
• Madhya Pradesh organizes the annual **Tansen Music Festival** in Gwalior to honor his legacy.
 
• The festival attracts musicians and music lovers from across the country and the world.
 
• The Tansen Samman is one of the prestigious awards in the Indian classical music community.
 
• The award not only honors the recipient but also promotes the rich musical traditions of India.
